_comment: SWARM-GUARD-6 (t_b5d509c4) per-minter allowlist for minter stamps. minter_version = minter_build_id() of the owning script file (mtime+size+md5[:8]); a stale/rewound build can never claim a newer stamp. skill_id must be listed per-class (or in class default_skills) or mint_card/mint_via REFUSE the mint (reason='skill-allowlist:<class>') — fail closed, so a minter can never smuggle an unreviewed preload. The skill is NOT auto-forced onto the card: preload enablement is the SEPARATE measured decision (see preload_measure).

preload_measure.rule: Do NOT enable heavier skill preload in the same change as the stamps. Before flipping any class default_skills into forced --skill preload, run ~/.hermes/scripts/preload_measure.py <CLASS> and compare median prompt tokens NULL-skills vs one forced skill (extra context is a plausible iteration-death cause).
